about: Old Home Distillers is a family farm distillery in Lebanon, Madison County, in the hills southeast of Syracuse. Jerry and Marlene Carvell founded it in 2015 in a converted hundred-year-old stable on historic Campbell Road, and their sons Aaron and Adam help run it. Production began that November with a single product, an unaged corn whiskey, the farm’s take on moonshine, and that corn whiskey is still the backbone of several of its spirits.

Peppershine is that original 100-proof corn whiskey, distilled in copper pot stills from New York corn, infused with real jalapeños grown locally. The distillery describes the heat as moderate and surprisingly well integrated, with the juicy flavour of the pepper’s flesh rather than just burn. It is bottled at 100 proof. It is built for mixing: Old Home suggests it in a Bloody Mary, in cider drinks, in jam cocktails, or in a “Moongarita,” its corn-whiskey answer to the Margarita.
